plantingWindowNote: Main season sowing: Late May to end of June. For flood-prone fields, direct sowing by early June prevents waterlogging damage.

milestones.label: Germination & Emergence
milestones.guidance: Inspect seed germination uniformity. Ensure crust is broken if rainfall occurred immediately after sowing.

milestones.label: Knee-High Stage (V6-V8)
milestones.guidance: Apply first top-dressing of nitrogen fertilizer (Urea). Clear weeds and ensure no standing water.

milestones.label: Tasseling (VT)
milestones.guidance: Critical water requirement stage. Water stress at tasseling can cause substantial yield reduction; schedule irrigation if rainfall is absent.

milestones.label: Silking & Pollination (R1)
milestones.guidance: Silks emerge from ears. Maintain adequate soil moisture. Avoid foliar chemical sprays during peak morning pollination.

milestones.label: Dough & Grain Filling (R4)
milestones.guidance: Kernels accumulate dry matter. Monitor for fall armyworm and stem borer infestation.

milestones.label: Physiological Maturity (R6 Black Layer)
milestones.guidance: Black layer forms at kernel base. Cease irrigation. Prepare combine harvester or labor for cob picking.

milestones.label: Harvest & Cob Drying
milestones.guidance: Harvest when grain moisture drops below 20%. Sun-dry to 12-14% moisture before storage.

plantingWindowNote: Optimum sowing window: October 25 to November 15. Delayed sowing after November 25 decreases yield by 35 kg/ha per day.

milestones.label: Crown Root Initiation (CRI)
milestones.guidance: Most critical irrigation stage. Irrigate 20-25 days after sowing. Apply first split of nitrogen.

milestones.label: Active Tillering
milestones.guidance: Perform weed eradication (Phalaris minor check). Second irrigation if soil moisture is below 50% field capacity.

milestones.label: Jointing & Stem Elongation
milestones.guidance: Nodes become visible above ground. Ensure uniform soil moisture. Monitor for yellow rust symptoms.

milestones.label: Flowering & Anthesis
milestones.guidance: Critical water sensitive stage. Provide light irrigation on calm non-windy days to avoid lodging.

milestones.label: Milking to Dough Stage
milestones.guidance: Terminal heat vigilance: maintain microclimate humidity. Final light irrigation if temperatures rise prematurely.

milestones.label: Maturity and Harvest
milestones.guidance: Harvest when straw turns golden yellow and grain is hard (moisture < 12%).

plantingWindowNote: Planting with pre-monsoon showers (May 1 to June 15). Raised bed or ridge-and-furrow planting recommended for heavy soils.

milestones.label: Rhizome Sprouting & Emergence (Stage A)
milestones.guidance: First mulching with green leaves (10-12 t/ha). Ensure good drainage to prevent rhizome rot.

milestones.label: Active Vegetative Growth (Stage B)
milestones.guidance: Second mulching and top dressing of N and K fertilizers. Earthing up around crop clumps.

milestones.label: Rhizome Development & Bulking (Stage C)
milestones.guidance: Expanding root and rhizome zone. Maintain consistent soil moisture (avoid alternate drying and saturation).

milestones.label: Foliage Senescence & Maturity
milestones.guidance: Leaves turn yellow and dry progressively from base. Stop all irrigation 15-20 days prior to harvest.

milestones.label: Rhizome Digging & Curing
milestones.guidance: Dig clumps carefully without injuring mother and finger rhizomes. Boil in water within 2-3 days for curing.

sourceVersion: Package of Practices for Southern Karnataka
plantingWindowNote: Kharif sowing: July 1 to August 15. Transplanted ragi nursery sowing: late June.

milestones.label: Transplanting / Thinning
milestones.guidance: Thin seedlings to 10 cm inter-plant spacing or transplant 3-week-old nursery seedlings in rows 30 cm apart.

milestones.label: Active Tillering & Weeding
milestones.guidance: Pass tyne cultivator or manual inter-cultivation. Top dress nitrogen before soil closure.

milestones.label: Panicle Initiation & Heading
milestones.guidance: Heading and flowering. Moisture conservation in drylands; protective irrigation if dry spell exceeds 14 days.

milestones.label: Grain Dough to Maturation
milestones.guidance: Earheads turn brown. Birds scaring and lodging prevention.

milestones.label: Earhead Harvest & Threshing
milestones.guidance: Cut mature brown earheads, dry on threshing floor to 10% moisture, thresh and clean grain.

plantingWindowNote: Spring/Summer (Zaid) sowing: February 15 to March 20. Rainy season (Kharif) sowing: June-July.

milestones.label: Seedling Emergence
milestones.guidance: Warm soil required for germination. Maintain light frequent irrigations.

milestones.label: First Flower Initiation
milestones.guidance: Yellow flowers appear. Inspect for yellow vein mosaic virus (YVMV) vectors (whiteflies).

milestones.label: First Fruit Picking
milestones.guidance: Pick tender green pods every 2-3 days. Continued picking stimulates fresh flower buds.

milestones.label: Peak Pod Harvesting & Irrigation
milestones.guidance: Irrigate at 4-5 day intervals during hot summer weather to keep pods tender.
